tiers.look: A chubby astronaut in a worn pastel suit, visor lifted, a bored face. Plain and proud.
Trim stripes, mirrored shades or goggles, and a hand-drawn extra: lollipop, straw, bubblegum, a silly hat.
Shiny metallic suit, glowing visor rim, gold chain or comms gear, sparks in the air.
Dark plasma-veined suit, glowing eyes, alien skin, a halo, particles and dripping plasma.
Gilded, void or cosmic suit, a face lost to fire or void, crown or halo, wings, aura rays. Includes five hand-made 1/1s.

oneOfOnes.title: The Original
oneOfOnes.note: The first astronaut: worn white suit, smoked visor, the most bored face in the galaxy.

oneOfOnes.title: Spaghettified
oneOfOnes.note: Helmet intact, body stretched into a noodle by tidal forces.

oneOfOnes.title: Singularity
oneOfOnes.note: A void-black suit with molten gold cracks, burning eyes and a halo.

oneOfOnes.title: Time Dilation
oneOfOnes.note: Echoes of one astronaut, caught between ticks.

oneOfOnes.title: The Crossed
oneOfOnes.note: Gilded suit, crown of light, photon wings: past the point of no return.
